# TestYieldToken
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/rwa-oracles/src/test-yield/TestYieldToken.sol)

**Inherits:**
ERC20, Ownable

**Title:**
TestYieldToken

**Author:**
Summer

ERC20 share token representing yield positions. Users deposit USDC and receive shares;
they deposit shares and receive USDC on withdrawal. Uses oracle price for conversion.

Deposit: user transfers USDC to this contract, owner calls processDeposit to mint shares.
Withdrawal: user transfers shares to this contract, owner calls processWithdraw to burn and send USDC.
Shares use 18 decimals; oracle price uses 8 decimals. Rounds down on both deposit and withdraw.


## State Variables
### usdc
USDC token address (6 decimals)


```solidity
IERC20 public immutable usdc
```


### oracle
Oracle providing price (8 decimals)


```solidity
AggregatorV3Interface public immutable oracle
```


### pocket
Pocket holding excess USDC (yield) separate from pending deposits


```solidity
YieldPocket public immutable pocket
```


### ORACLE_DECIMALS

```solidity
uint8 public constant ORACLE_DECIMALS = 8
```


### USDC_DECIMALS

```solidity
uint8 public constant USDC_DECIMALS = 6
```


## Functions
### constructor


```solidity
constructor(
    string memory name,
    string memory symbol,
    address _usdc,
    address _oracle,
    address _owner
)
    ERC20(name, symbol)
    Ownable(_owner);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`name`|`string`|ERC20 name|
|`symbol`|`string`|ERC20 symbol (typically ticker)|
|`_usdc`|`address`|USDC token address|
|`_oracle`|`address`|Price oracle (AggregatorV3Interface)|
|`_owner`|`address`|Owner (factory) for processDeposit/processWithdraw|


### getPocket

Returns the pocket contract address.


```solidity
function getPocket() external view returns (address);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`address`|Address of the YieldPocket holding excess USDC.|


### processDeposit

Process a deposit: mint shares to user for USDC already in this contract.

USDC is moved to pocket after minting. Rounds down share amount. Reverts if price <= 0.


```solidity
function processDeposit(address user, uint256 usdcAmount) external onlyOwner;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`user`|`address`|Address to receive minted shares.|
|`usdcAmount`|`uint256`|Amount of USDC (6 decimals) to convert. Must be in this contract.|


### processWithdraw

Process a withdrawal: burn shares held by this contract and send USDC to user.

Pulls from pocket if main contract has insufficient USDC. Rounds down USDC amount. Reverts if price <= 0.


```solidity
function processWithdraw(address user, uint256 sharesAmount) external onlyOwner;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`user`|`address`|Address to receive USDC.|
|`sharesAmount`|`uint256`|Amount of shares (18 decimals) to burn. Must be held by this contract.|


### recoverERC20

Rescue accidentally sent ERC20 tokens.


```solidity
function recoverERC20(address token, uint256 amount) external onlyOwner;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`token`|`address`|Token address to rescue.|
|`amount`|`uint256`|Amount to transfer to owner.|
